title: Sequence coefficient pullback comparison
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell and f:X→Y any scheme map. The sequence-site coefficient map ringMap ell E f none is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Restrict the product-site adjunction to every coefficient index. The finite comparisons form compatible families, and the resulting componentwise inverse proves the map is invertible on the sequence sheaf.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientPullback_none_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : IsIso (ringMap ell E f none)
